name: feat-2738
title: #2738 — every point that moves on a curve gets the locus chip, even when other points move too (PR, port 5174)

cases.title: Two points on two separate circles: each has the chip and shows its own circle

after.say: לחצו «הצג מקום גאומטרי» בשורה של M
לחצו «הצג מקום גאומטרי» בשורה של N

cases.lookFor: «הצג מקום גאומטרי» on the row of M and on the row of N. Pressing both: M answers «מעגל · x² + y² = 2²» and N answers «מעגל · (x − 6)² + y² = 1²», each circle traced.

cases.title: Two points on the same circle: each has the chip

after.say: לחצו «הצג מקום גאומטרי» בשורה של M

cases.lookFor: A chip on the row of M and on the row of N; pressing M's answers «מעגל · x² + y² = 2²», and N stays where it is while M's circle is traced.

cases.title: A locus point beside an unrelated quadrilateral keeps its chip

after.say: לחצו «הצג מקום גאומטרי» בשורה של M

cases.lookFor: The chip stays on «נקודה M» after «מרובע»; pressing it answers «ישר · x - 2 = 0», the same as without the quadrilateral.
cases.before: The chip disappeared as soon as «מרובע» was typed.

cases.title: The midpoint of two moving points has no chip (its positions fill a region)
cases.lookFor: Chips on M's and N's rows; NO chip on the row «K אמצע MN».

cases.title: …and a chord length gives the midpoint its chip
cases.lookFor: Continue from T8 by typing «MN = 2». K's row now has the chip; pressing it answers «מעגל · x² + y² = 3».
cases.before: Unchanged (K's chip appeared here before too).

after.say: לחצו «הצג מקום גאומטרי» בשורה של K

cases.title: A kite on a stated diagonal: A and C get chips (they slide along the diagonal)

after.say: לחצו «הצג מקום גאומטרי» בשורה של A

cases.lookFor: Two chips on the «דלתון ABCD» row, ending with A and with C. Pressing A's answers «ישר · 2x - y = 0», the diagonal.
